name: PDS_3_Usability_Accessibility_Assessment
title: PDS.3 Usability/Accessibility Assessment (Function)
description: This category is about the assessment of usability during the product development cycle, for the intended use by a target audience.
purpose:
Certain accessibility requirements (usability for users with specific disabilities) are recommended, but the list is not exhaustive. Other
disabilities not mentioned (e.g., cognitive/learning disabilities) should be considered under the umbrella of conformance criterion #1.

statement.label: PDS.3#01
statement.requirement: The system SHALL be assessed against an industry-validated usability assessment tool using subjects who are demographically similar to the intended users (target audience). User types may include, for example, those with motor disabilities, visual impairment, or auditory disabilities.

statement.label: PDS.3#02
statement.requirement: IF the system displays AI output to consumers THEN the system SHALL assess, with representative intended users, whether consumers can understand that an output is AI-assisted, the output's intended purpose, its material limitations, and the appropriate next step.

statement.label: PDS.3#03
statement.requirement: The system SHOULD undergo non-functional usability testing that assesses its user-friendliness, performance reliability, and adherence to end-user expectations for the targeted consumer group.

statement.label: PDS.3#04
statement.requirement: The system SHOULD have a written usability assessment plan that includes known product usability problems and a mitigation plan.

statement.label: PDS.3#05
statement.requirement: The system SHOULD follow the design and style guide standards established by the platform provider(s) on which it runs, such as Android or iOS.

statement.label: PDS.3#06
statement.requirement: The system SHOULD avoid excessive data use, minimize data use as far as practicable, and warn the user when high data usage occurs, such as during downloads and updates.

statement.label: PDS.3#07
statement.requirement: The system SHOULD be supported by a requirements analysis that describes the use cases (business scenarios) and intended users for its main functions.

statement.label: PDS.3#08
statement.requirement: IF the system uses AI functionality THEN the system SHOULD assess cognitive burden, health literacy, language accessibility, disability access, and the likelihood that interface design could cause users to over-trust or misunderstand AI output.

statement.label: PDS.3#09
statement.requirement: The system SHOULD permit adaptation to the user's specific abilities, needs, or requirements.

statement.label: PDS.3#10
statement.requirement: The system SHOULD provide information about its accessibility characteristics in the product description and in the contextual assistance sections of the system.

statement.label: PDS.3#11
statement.requirement: IF the system uses AI functionality THEN the system MAY provide an accessible explanation mode that uses plain language, translated text, visual aids, or other adaptive presentation methods.
